result.title: Learning hidden-state dynamics from unpaired snapshots with lift-project SDEs
result.summary: Many systems are observed only through unpaired snapshots, with population samples available at each time point but no correspondence between samples at different times. These snapshots determine the one-time distributions but leave the temporal coupling unspecified, requiring a modeling prior to connect successive times. We propose the lift-project stochastic differential equation (SDE), an autonomous SDE on the observed coordinate and a few hidden coordinates, trained only to match the snapshots. Most existing methods, including time-dependent SDEs, Schrödinger bridges and optimal transport, evolve the observed coordinate alone. For a scalar observation, the classical comparison theorem implies that all such models have non-negative lagged covariance, so on data whose lagged covariance turns negative, their error has a computable floor. The lift-project SDE is not bound by this floor. On two representative partially observed systems, the Duffing and pendulum oscillators, at comparable fit to the snapshots, the proposed method reduces the lagged-covariance error by factors of 2.4 and 6.6 relative to the strongest baseline and is the only model below the error floor; one hidden coordinate is already enough for such improvement. Furthermore, if a second experiment changes only the initial state of the hidden coordinate, no single model that evolves the observed coordinate alone can fit both experiments, whereas a single lift-project SDE can.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究仅有无配对时间快照、缺少跨时刻对应关系时如何建模动力学，提出在观测坐标外加少量隐藏坐标的 lift-project SDE，只用快照匹配训练，并证明仅演化观测坐标的模型在标量观测下滞后协方差非负、存在可计算误差下界，而所提方法可突破该下界。
AI.relevance_reason: 隐藏坐标的必要性与「仅用可观测量的模型存在误差下界」这一论证，可能与 LVR 中内部 latent 状态承载任务必要信息、以及用下界/诊断评估 latent 是否真正被使用的思路类比，但领域相距较远，可迁移性仅供核查。
